Read-only task — do NOT apply, check, or edit anything. TEST branch only.

1. Run `buildprint sync` first to pull the latest snapshot.
2. Read the styles/ folder in the shredded worktree and report the app's
   design system as it currently exists in Bubble. I want the ACTUAL values,
   not a summary. Cover:
   - Color variables / app colors (name → hex, incl. any opacity variants)
   - Font/text styles (name, font family, size, weight, line-height, color)
   - Element styles (buttons, inputs, groups, etc.) and their key properties
   - App fonts loaded (uploaded/Google) and default font
   - Any spacing / border-radius / shadow tokens defined as styles
3. Present it as a plain table grouped by category, exact values.
4. Flag anything that looks inconsistent or duplicated (e.g. two greys, an
   unnamed style, hardcoded colors not tied to a variable).

Do not change files. Do not run apply. Just report.

Synced, read-only throughout — nothing changed. Here is the CRS design system as it currently exists in Bubble (test branch).

---

# CRS Design System — Actual Values (styles/, test branch)

Source of truth: `styles/tokens.json` (colors), `styles/fonts.json` (fonts), `styles/defaults.json` (default style per element type), plus ~1,000 element-style JSON files. Colors are referenced two ways: **system tokens** `var(--color_<name>_default)` (e.g. `text`, `surface`, `background`, `primary`, `destructive`) and **user tokens** `var(--color_bp…_default)` (the 48 named colors below). Many older styles bypass both and hardcode `rgba(...)`.

## 2. Fonts

- **Default app font:** `Inter` (`font_tokens.default`). Referenced in styles as `var(--font_default)`.
- **One custom font token:** "Label" = **Inter Tight** (id `bUlSl0`, referenced as `var(--font_bUlSl0_default)`) — used by badges/muted labels.
- **Other font families appearing directly in text styles** (not tokenized): **JetBrains Mono** (all mono/KPI/code/alphabet-rail styles), **Roboto** (two legacy "Label 14px" styles), and literal `"Inter"` / `"Inter Tight"` hardcoded in a handful of styles instead of the token.
- No separate uploaded/Google-font manifest exists in the shred beyond these tokens; Inter / Inter Tight / JetBrains Mono are Google fonts, Roboto is a stray.

## 3. Text / Font Styles (239 styles)

The typographic system is large but coherent. Core scale (all `var(--font_default)` = Inter unless noted; color = user token):

| Style | Family | Size | Weight | LH | Color |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| CRS - Display | Inter | 32 | 700 | 1.15 | Text Primary |
| CRS - H1 | Inter | 24 | 700 | 1.2 | Text Primary |
| CRS - H2 | Inter | 20 | 600 | 1.25 | Text Primary |
| CRS - H3 | Inter | 16 | 600 | 1.35 | Text Primary |
| CRS - Body | Inter | 14 | 400 | 1.55 | Text Secondary |
| CRS - Body Strong | Inter | 14 | 500 | 1.55 | Text Primary |
| CRS - Body Small | Inter | 13 | 400 | 1.5 | Text Secondary |
| CRS - Caption | Inter | 12 | 400 | 1.4 | Text Muted |
| CRS - Label | Inter | 12 | 600 | 1.4 | Text Secondary |
| CRS - Overline | Inter | 11 | 700 | 1.3 | Text Muted |
| CRS - Link | Inter | 14 | 500 | 1.55 | Accent Text |
| CRS - Code | JetBrains Mono | 13 | 500 | 1.5 | Text Secondary |
| CRS - Mono Value 24px | JetBrains Mono | 24 | 700 | 1.1 | Text Primary |
| CRS - Mono Value 16px | JetBrains Mono | 16 | 600 | 1.5 | Text Primary |
| CRS - Mono Meta 12px | JetBrains Mono | 12 | 600 | 1.4 | Text Secondary |

Plus full matrices (each with a `· Light` twin): **Avatar Initials/Name/Meta** (SM/MD/LG), **Badge** (Amber/Blue/Cyan/Green/Purple/Red/Neutral — colored ones hardcode rgba, see flags), **Mono Delta** (Positive/Negative/Warning), **Chip** (Label/Value/Close), **Breadcrumb** (Root/Current/Separator), **Status Text/Tag**, **Filter Chip**, **Pager Cell**, **Pill**, plus older `Text___*` H1/H2/H3/Primary/Secondary/Muted/Lable families and legacy `Text_body_10…72` / `Text_headline_30…72` size ladders. Line-heights in use: 1, 1.1, 1.15, 1.2, 1.25, 1.27, 1.3, 1.35, 1.4, 1.5, 1.55, 1.6, 1.65, 1.7. Sizes: 9–32 (plus legacy headline 30–72).

## 4. Element Styles — defaults + key values

**App defaults** (`defaults.json`) and their exact base values:

| Element | Default style | Base values |
|---|---|---|
| Button | `Button_0001___button_standard_secondary_44px_` | bg **rgba(33,33,33,1)**, border **rgba(58,58,58,1)**, radius 6, font `surface`, size 16/500, pad 16, gap 8, LH 1.7 — *bg/border hardcoded* |
| Input | `Input___input_48_` | bg **rgba(36,36,36,1)**, border **rgba(50,50,50,1)**, radius 6, font **rgba(224,224,224,1)**, size 16, placeholder **rgba(138,138,138,1)** — *fully hardcoded* |
| MultiLineInput | `MultiLineInput___primary_36_` | bg `primary_contrast`, border **rgba(42,42,42,1)**, radius 6, font `surface`, size 14 |
| Dropdown | `Dropdown___primart_36_` *(name typo "Primart")* | bg `primary_contrast`, border **rgba(42,42,42,1)**, radius 6, font `surface`, size 14 |
| Icon | `Icon_crs___icon_button_32_` | icon `surface`, border **rgba(41,43,47,0.2)**, no size |
| Group | `Group_transparent___raw_` | transparent, radius 6, no border/shadow/pad (bare container) |
| FloatingGroup | `FloatingGroup_standard_` | bg `White` |
| Popup | `Popup_standard_` | bg `White`, border `Text Secondary`, radius 8, greyout blur 16 @ `BG Elevated` 0.5 |
| GroupFocus | `GroupFocus_standard_` | bg `White`, border `Text Secondary`, radius 6, shadow 0/12/16/-4 `Black` 0.1 |
| RepeatingGroup | `RepeatingGroup_horizontal_50px_` | border/separator **rgba(41,43,47,0.2)**, radius 6 |
| Shape | `Shape_0001___separator_` | bg **rgba(42,42,42,1)** (divider) |
| DateInput | `DateInput_standard_…` → `DateInput_standard_.json` | Bubble stock "Standard": bg `White`, border `Text Secondary`, radius 6 |
| AutocompleteDropdown | `…_standard_…` → `AutocompleteDropdown_standard_.json` | stock "Standard" |
| FileInput | `…_standard_uploader_` → `FileInput_standard_.json` | stock "Standard" |
| Image | `Image_simple_image_` → `Image_standard_.json` | stock (empty props) |
| PictureInput | `PictureInput_standard_image_uploader_` | **no matching file** — only `PictureInput_crs___image_uploader_` exists |

**Canonical (fully tokenized) button matrix** — `Button_crs___ds_*` (256 styles, variant × size 28/32/36/40/48 × icon × light):
- primary: bg/border `Accent`, font/icon `White`, radius 6, 14/500, pad 14 (hover `Accent Hover`, pressed `Accent Active`, disabled `BG Elevated`)
- secondary: bg/border `BG Elevated`, font `surface`
- ghost: bg `Transparent`, no border, font `surface`
- destructive: bg/border `Error`, font `White`

**Canonical card/panel groups** (`Group_crs*`, fully tokenized):
- KPI Card: bg `BG Secondary`, border `Border Default`, radius 6, pad 16, no shadow
- Elevated Card: bg `BG Secondary`, border `Border Default`, radius 10
- Outline Card: bg `Transparent`, border `Border Hover`, radius 8
- Menu Panel: bg `BG Secondary`, border `Border Active`, radius 8
- Translucent Card: bg `rgba(var(--color_bpbstl_rgb),0.45)` (token-in-rgba)

**Custom control matrices** (all `_crs_`, tokenized, dark+light): Input 32/36/40/44px, Textarea, Dropdown 36px, DateInput, Search Input, Image Uploader (dashed), Avatar Photo (radius 100). Inputs use bg `BG Tertiary`, border `Input Border`, radius 6, font `Text Primary`, placeholder `Text Muted`.

## 5. De-facto spacing / radius / shadow tokens

There are **no** spacing/radius/shadow entries in `tokens.json` — colors are the only defined tokens. Radius, padding, and shadow live per-element-style. Observed:

- **Border-radius:** 0, 2, 6 (dominant default), 8 (panels/cards), 10 (elevated card), 100 & 999 (pills / avatars / switches). Buttons/inputs standardize on **6**.
- **Padding:** button/input horizontal 14–16; card 16.
- **Box-shadow** (color inconsistent — mix of `Black` alpha and token-in-rgba): GroupFocus 0/12/16/-4 `Black` 0.1; medium card 0/8/12 `Black` 0.1–0.3; popover 0/8/24/+8 `Black` 0.4; KPI hover glow `Accent` @ 0→0.3. Most `crs_` cards ship `boxshadow_style: none`.

## 6. Flags — inconsistencies & duplication

**Hardcoded colors not tied to a variable** (biggest issue):
- **The app's own defaults are the worst offenders:** the default Button, Input, Dropdown, MultiLineInput, DateInput all hardcode rgba (bg/border/placeholder) instead of tokens — so new elements dropped on a page do **not** inherit the token system. The clean, tokenized `Button_crs___ds_*` and `*_crs_*` control styles exist but are **not** the defaults.
- ~15% of buttons hardcode base bg; ~28% hardcode a color somewhere (mostly hover/pressed/disabled states). Legacy `Group___card_main*`, RepeatingGroup default, Shape default all hardcode greys.
- All colored **Badge/Pill text styles** hardcode rgba (e.g. Badge Blue `rgba(106,141,199,1)`, Pill Green `rgba(74,222,128,1)`) instead of using the Success/Error/Purple/Cyan tokens that exist for exactly this.
- Two legacy "Label 14px" text styles use **Roboto** + `rgba(160,160,160,1)` — off-system font and off-palette grey.
- Heavy hardcoded rgba also lives in the app's `custom_header` CSS (date-picker theming) — only the accent uses a token there.

**Duplicate / redundant greys & colors:**
- Multiple near-identical dark greys hardcoded across styles: `rgba(30,30,30,1)`, `rgba(31,31,31,1)`, `rgba(33,33,33,1)`, `rgba(36,36,36,1)`, `rgba(38,38,38,1)`, `rgba(41,43,47,…)`, `rgba(42,42,42,1)`, `rgba(50,50,50,1)`, `rgba(58,58,58,1)` — these overlap with BG Secondary/Tertiary/Elevated, Border Default/Hover, Input Border tokens but aren't linked.
- Accent Text (bpbsua) == Accent (bpbstx) == rgba(59,130,246,1); Warning (bpbsuv) mirrors system `alert`; Error (bpbsut) == system `destructive`. Several tokens are exact duplicates across the system/user layers.

**Duplicate / legacy styles:**
- **Buttons: 456 total, ~3 generations of the same button** (`Button_001___primary_button_`, `Button_crs___ds_primary_36px_`, and auto-id `bpuvlxcwbfw`). ~27 `_copy` clone chains (up to 8 deep), 6 random auto-id styles (filename ≠ internal id). ~1/3 is superseded cruft.
- **Groups: 201 total**, ~40–50 legacy (`Group___card_main*`, `Group_____*`, numbered `_0001/_001/_1/_01`) superseded by `Group_crs*`. 5 auto-id orphans (`bpuvlxcwbgn–r`).
- **Copy-chains everywhere:** every Input/Dropdown/DateInput/FileInput/Autocomplete/Link/Image folder has `_copy`, `_copy_copy`, `_copy_copy_copy` variants (Autocomplete is a 4-deep chain).
- **Text: 18 orphaned styles with no `id` field** (`Text_body_*`, `Text_headline_*`); 9 `bpuvlxcwbg*` files whose filename ≠ internal id. True duplicate: `Text___muted_text___11_` and `…_11_1` are byte-identical.

**Naming / data-quality bugs:**
- Typos baked into IDs: **`Dropdown___primart_36_`** (the Dropdown default — "primart"), `Input_1_transparrent_`, `Group_1_modail_main`, `Group_hover_transprent_`, pervasive "Lable" for "Label".
- Mismatched id/display/size: `Text___secondary_16_` is displayed "Secondary Text - 14" and is actually 14px; `Text_0001___label_14px_dark_` is actually 12px.
- `FileInput_standard_copy_copy_` sets `font_color` to the **background/transparent** token (invisible text — likely a bug).
- `PictureInput` default points to a style file that doesn't exist (only the `_crs_` uploader is present).

**Bottom line:** the intended design system is the token layer (48 named colors, Inter/Inter Tight/JetBrains Mono) plus the fully-tokenized `*_crs_*` / `Button_crs___ds_*` style families. The gap is that (a) the **element defaults still point at older hardcoded styles**, so the token system isn't applied automatically, and (b) roughly a third of the style files are legacy/duplicate cruft (copy-chains, auto-ids, superseded generations) sitting alongside the clean set.

No files were changed; no check/apply run.
